text:
anya: Heads-up — p99 token-latency spike in us-east1 around 09:13 UTC. Panels 'Token SLO — token_latency_by_shard' and 'Tokens/sec distribution' show a concentrated tail on one shard. Looks correlated with GPU capacity pressure + envoy egress queueing. Anyone else seeing TTFT jump for short prompts? :thinking_face: https://grafana.redwood/d/abcd/token-slo

mike: yep, saw it. heatmap points to us-east1-azb shard-7 at ~85% GPU util; KV cache hit rate dropped ~12% -> more cold starts. autoscaler didn't seem to ramp fast enough.

infra-oncall: I'm digging into node-pool events + autoscaler logs now. Kicked a scale-up for us-east1-azb. Also seeing envoy egress queue_length spike on egress-proxy-2.

kevin: quick note on alerts — p95 alert currently at 400ms is noisy with our new batching; suggest a recording rule to normalize tail by tokens/sec before alerting.

lucy: PromQL I used to reproduce the tail:
```promql
histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(token_latency_bucket[5m])) by (le, shard))
```
Would be useful to roll this up by cluster_id and queue_type and break out by prompt_length buckets.

mike: also seeing a short cost blip — tokens/sec up but per-1k-token cost increased because of more small prompts (per-call overhead). We should add tokens/sec per-customer to the cost dashboard so we can trace spikes to noisy tenants.

grafana-bot: Alert fired: token-latency-p99-us-east1 at 2098765440 — https://grafana.redwood/alert/12345 :rotating_light:

infra-oncall: scaled pool + cordoned a noisy host (gpu-us1-012). KV cache warmed for shard-7; p99 started dropping. Alerts cleared ~2098765560 in the dashboard. I'll keep monitoring.

anya: great. can someone add a recording rule + panel that buckets 'ttft' by prompt_length (<=32, 33-128, >128)? small prompts are where we see the worst tail and it's masking overall medians.

kevin: I'll open a PR. Proposed recording rule (draft):
```yaml
- record: job:token_latency_p99_per_token_rate:ratio
  expr: |
    (histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(token_latency_bucket[5m])) by (le, shard))
     / max(1, sum(rate(tokens_count[5m])) by (shard)))
```
Proposed alert: token_latency_p99_normalized{region="us-east1"} > 0.5 and tokens_per_second < 200 for 10m. Thoughts?

mike: +1. Also would like autoscaler events as annotations in Grafana so we can correlate scale decisions with latency spikes (we don't have that today).

lucy: FYI logs from autoscaler indicate cloud-provider API throttling delayed scale decision:
`kubectl -n infra logs deploy/autoscaler -f` showed repeated 429s and backoff.

sre-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-455 — impact: ~1% of requests in us-east1 had p99 > 1.2s. Assigned: infra-oncall.

infra-oncall: follow-up: increased autoscaler backoff jitter and added a short cooldown to reduce thrash. also cordoned the noisy node; continuing to watch metrics. will post updated graphs in ~30m.

anya: thanks all. i'll add a small eval prompt set to measure quality regressions from the tail and update the watch dashboard. :thumbsup:

kevin: PR queued for recording rule + alert tweak. will ping when merged.

mike: once PR lands i'll add tokens-per-customer panel and an annotation pipeline for autoscaler k8s events.

infra-oncall: monitoring shows p99 at 1.1s at peak -> down to 420ms after intervention. closing loop but keeping watch for 2h.

anya: perfect, leaving this thread pinned for the follow-up. if anything else fires, @infra-oncall please escalate.
